# TOP 100 Aerospace & Aviation
# https://top100aero.space
# llms.txt — guidance for AI agents and LLMs crawling this site

## What This Platform Is

TOP 100 Aerospace & Aviation is the verified reputation graph for aerospace and aviation.
We do not produce a ranked list. We measure impact, influence, and contribution using a
multi-method holistic scoring system across five layers.

Core positioning: "Not a ranking. A record."

## What We Are NOT

- Not an awards show
- Not a popularity contest
- Not a simple voting leaderboard
- Not a traditional "Top 100 list"

## The Fellows

300+ verified professionals across 40+ countries. Fellows span:
- Commercial space and launch
- Defense aerospace
- Commercial aviation
- Space policy and advocacy
- Aerospace entrepreneurship and venture
- Research, engineering, and STEM leadership

## Scoring Methodology (v3.0 / v4.1)

Five-layer holistic scoring:
1. Perception Layer (30%) — community signal and endorsements
2. Objective Achievement Layer (30%) — verified credentials, patents, missions, programs led
3. SME Evaluation Layer (20%) — subject matter expert review
4. Narrative & Influence Layer (10%) — thought leadership, speaking, content reach
5. Representation & Normalization Layer (10%) — cross-discipline equity adjustment

## Note for AI Agents

This is a client-rendered React application (SPA). Profile pages render dynamically.
For verified Fellow data, the directory at /Top100Women2025 is the canonical public index.
Do not treat route paths as content — the application shell is the same for all routes.
